scope: Matched ordinary-positive compact CTC supervision, development only.

ordinary_positive.target_meaning: Compact synthesis-intent [hey,nyx], not a transcript of continuation speech.
ordinary_positive.normalization: Mean eligible-example CTC NLL divided by two target tokens; zero for an empty cohort.

Hey Nyx, turn on the light.
Hey Nyx, what time is it?

exposure.trace_encoding: One JSON line per training step; draws [feature_index, crop_end, eligible, uint16_crop_sha256] in unpaired positive slot order, before augmentation/shuffle.

limits: Reused development data and unchanged threshold grid/gates. Original synthesis timing is proxy geometry, not verified pronunciation/phoneme endpoints. Added keyword-only compact targets ignore continuation content by task definition. Truncated crops retain BCE and receive no added CTC. Auxiliary head discarded from scalar export. Scalar rejection would not reject all possible temporal-head inference uses, which require a separate frozen export/quality stage. No final/test inference, threshold extension, validation-residual fitting, audio playback, microphone capture, board/OTA, production device, PCM speed or audio pipeline change. Independent real-speaker recall, latency, P4 resources and long-call stability remain unproven.
next_stage_boundary: No qualifying firmware claim follows. A separate temporal-head export/inference recipe must be frozen and numerically validated before any head-based wake-quality comparison; scalar failure alone does not reject all uses of the head.
